Ratio — Cursed Technique Reversal

With great mastery over the Reversed Cursed Technique, you have found the reversal of your technique. You have learnt how to invert your own ratio, placing it onto yourself to develop weak points but the effect causes all areas excluding those weak points to be reinforced beyond comparison. As a bonus action or reaction whenever an attack is made against you or you roll a saving throw for 8 cursed energy, you can impose the ratio onto your body for a number of rounds equal to CE modifier (minimum of 1). By doing so, you roll a d10 every time an attack roll is made against you or you make a saving throw. If you roll anything other than a 3 or 7, you gain resistance to all damage taken, damage reduction equaling half of your level, rounded down (damage reduction occurs after damage resistance), and any damage resistance you have prior to placing the ratio onto yourself becomes damage immunity. If you roll a 3 or 7, the attack roll hits regardless of your AC or you automatically fail the save.
